items.title: Labarbera interviewed by Monk Rowe, 2021
items.q: we’re doing a tune that he did with Elvin Jones.

ctx.x: Yeah, especially with Pat, ‘cause Pat was the one who led us all. Pat was out there first. He was the trailblazer. You know I’m the middle, well-adjusted son. But he was the one who took all the blows. He’s the one who got me on Buddy Rich’s band you know. He, you know he would, I’d call him for some advice. Yup. And he’s so knowledgeable. I’ll

still call him about certain changes. I’ll say, on this tune, actually I just did that recently ‘cause we’re doing a tune that he did with Elvin Jones. I’m doing it on my next recording. And I would call him and say what the hell is this, what is all this stuff. And of course he’s got it all in his head. He’s got all these tunes. And he would give me some ideas. Because not everything is consistent in, even in modal writing, nothing is that consistent and there’s always something new to bridge, something new to…
What do your piano parts look like?
